extracted.name: Pumpkin spice latte
extracted.description: Get cosy with a pumpkin spice latte, perfect for cold autumn and winter nights. With ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg and pumpkin flavours, it's a real treat
ingredient_lines: pinch of ground cinnamon plus extra to serve (or use pumpkin spice)
instruction_lines: Put the pumpkin purée in a large heatproof glass or mug. Stir in the spices and espresso or strong coffee.

Heat the milk in a saucepan over a low heat until steaming and frothy. Pour into the glass or mug, and spoon over any froth. Stir to combine, then dust with more cinnamon or some pumpkin spice before serving.
